mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter indicates weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 QoQ < -1% does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points month-over-month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE MoM > 0.5pp does not correlate with subsequent labor market weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over three consecutive months signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or the easing cycle does not correlate with subsequent positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and decrease in Retail and Food Services Sales (RSAFS) signals a shift in consumer spending from goods to housing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction between HOUST and RSAFS does not correlate with subsequent positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO MoM > 1% does not correlate with subsequent supply-side strength.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 month-over-month signals labor market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or PAYEMS MoM < -100,000 does not correlate with subsequent labor market weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with an increase in Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals accommodative monetary policy in an inflationary environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < previous month AND CPIAUCSL MoM > 0.5%
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent positive returns.
